## Validation

List exact commands and outcomes. Keep CPU-only, Isaac Sim/GPU, and real-hardware evidence separate.

## Compatibility and boundaries

- [ ] Observations and action order/width are unchanged, or a maintainer approved the change
- [ ] No new credential, private path, customer/field data, or internal-only dependency is included
- [ ] New or changed assets, motion data, models, binaries, or generated files include provenance,
      checksums, and approved license/use terms
- [ ] License and copyright notices are preserved
- [ ] Dependency, build, installation, runtime, public API, and file-format changes are called out
- [ ] Robot-control and real-hardware safety impact is described, or this change has none
